newsitem.title: INDIA: Twenty wedding guests die in collision in India.
newsitem.headline: Twenty wedding guests die in collision in India.

text.p: Twenty people were killed and 25 injured when a crowded van carrying wedding guests collided with a truck in southern India, the Press Trust of India said on Monday.

Police said eight people, including three women and a child, died on the spot in the head-on collision on Sunday. The others died later despite medical care at the site or in hospitals in the capital of Karnataka state, Bangalore.
